title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a Hospital in the Sub-Province of Quirino, Nueva Vizcaya, to Be Known as the Quirino Sub-Provincial Hospital, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a Hospital in the Sub-Province of Quirino, Nueva Vizcaya, to Be Known as the Quirino Sub-Provincial Hospital, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5553_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be establish under the direct supervision of the Director of Medical Services, a hospital in the Sub-province of Quirino, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, to be known as the Quirino Sub-Provincial Hospital. The site of said hospital, to be determined by the Secretary of Health or his representative, shall be in the subcapital of the Sub-Province.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said hospital for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and seventy. Thereafter, such sums as may, be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
